description: For leads with a website but no named contact, search the open web for the people the business names (owner, founder, director), then resolve and verify their email in the same run. Costs 2 tokens per person found, verification included; the run reserves 2 tokens per business up front and settles on what it delivered, so the most a run can cost is 2 tokens per lead id sent. Separate from enrichment, which already lists the people a business's own site names, with a verified email where one exists, at no extra charge. This is what reaches local business owners who are not in any LinkedIn-derived contact database. Returns a job id, poll with get_job_status. Outcomes per lead: verified (SMTP-confirmed), published (the address is printed on the company's own site but the domain is catch-all so SMTP cannot confirm it), catch_all (person named, no address obtainable), or searched (no name found).

result_ids.description: Lead ids to search. Only leads with a website and no personal email yet are eligible; ineligible ids are skipped and not charged.
